scenario: a fashion ecommerce site tracking add-to-cart and conversion
title: Clean cart snapshot tags and extract keywords
prompt: You are analyzing cart abandonment data from a fashion ecommerce platform modeled on public retail inventory datasets (data.gov). The `cart_snapshots` table captures the moment a visitor adds items to their cart, along with free-form `behavior_tags` that marketing staff enter to describe why the session might convert or abandon (e.g., `first_visit; browsing only`, `REPEAT_BUYER,price-sensitive`, `mobile user | NEW | discount code applied`). These tags are inconsistently delimited (commas, semicolons, pipes) and inconsistently cased. Your goal is to clean these tags: (1) normalize all delimiters to a single space, (2) convert each tag to title case, (3) extract the resulting cleaned tag array, and (4) pull out the first keyword (the first cleaned tag) to report alongside the snapshot ID and visitor session code. Write a query that transforms the `behavior_tags` column by replacing all commas, semicolons, and pipes with a single space using a regular expression, splits the result into an array on space boundaries, converts each element to title case during display, and returns the snapshot ID, session code, the full cleaned tag array, and the first tag. Include all snapshots. Order the output by `snapshot_id` ascending.
schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE cart_snapshots (snapshot_id INT PRIMARY KEY, session_code VARCHAR(20), visitor_email VARCHAR(100), behavior_tags TEXT, item_count INT, cart_value_usd NUMERIC(10,2), added_at TIMESTAMP);
answer_key:
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT
    snapshot_id,
    session_code,
    NULLIF(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(behavior_tags, '[,;|[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')), '') AS norm
  FROM cart_snapshots
)
SELECT
  snapshot_id,
  session_code,
  CASE WHEN norm IS NULL THEN NULL
       ELSE (SELECT ARRAY_AGG(INITCAP(tag))
             FROM UNNEST(STRING_TO_ARRAY(norm, ' ')) AS tag)
  END AS cleaned_tags_array,
  CASE WHEN norm IS NULL THEN NULL
       ELSE INITCAP((STRING_TO_ARRAY(norm, ' '))[1])
  END AS first_keyword
FROM normalized
ORDER BY snapshot_id;
user_solution:
/*
STRING_TO_ARRAY(INITCAP(REGEXP_REPLACE(behavior_tags, '[;|[:space:]]+', 'g')), ',')
*/

SELECT
    snapshot_id,
    session_code,
    STRING_TO_ARRAY(INITCAP(REGEXP_REPLACE(behavior_tags, '[,;|[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')), ' ') AS cleaned_tags_array,
    (STRING_TO_ARRAY(INITCAP(REGEXP_REPLACE(behavior_tags, '[,;|[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')), ' '))[1] AS first_keyword
FROM cart_snapshots
ORDER BY snapshot_id;
